exitCriteria.title: The scheduled job runs exactly four times daily in both halves of the year, verified across a daylight saving transition
exitCriteria.reason: The schedule gate selects the four required America/Vancouver hours, but the dated 100-run receipt records 56 gated no-ops, 44 attempted-refresh failures, and zero real refresh successes. The workflow now writes through a bot branch and pull request; this code change is not evidence that a scheduled run has succeeded.

exitCriteria.title: Both public routes retain the five required safety display fields and block deployment if one is absent
exitCriteria.reason: Rendered route tests require source updated, last successful refresh, source agency, next scheduled refresh, and official emergency information in both English and French; deleting a field fails the validator.

exitCriteria.title: At 25 hours without a successful refresh, the static route shows unavailable guidance and an agency link
exitCriteria.reason: The stale-state contract begins after 24 hours, removes the derived illustrative summary, and retains official-agency guidance. The workflow test covers the stricter 25-hour case through the same persisted last-success state.

exitCriteria.title: A full simulated season of immutable snapshots is retained and queryable by bounded time range
exitCriteria.reason: The local store writes each raw snapshot with exclusive create, never queries current.json as history, and the simulated May–September season test retains 612 snapshots then queries a bounded July interval.

productionBlockers.reason: No production route may use the fixture or any configured endpoint until every feed has a documented authoritative endpoint, rights, version/snapshot contract, archive admission, and production approval. SOPFEU remains rights-and-snapshot-blocked.
There is no observed production scheduler/storage/monitoring/on-call rehearsal for outage, schema change, stale state, and daylight-saving transitions. Local simulation is not operational evidence.

safetyBoundary: This local contract provides context only: it is not emergency direction, a spread prediction, or a damage map.
